newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine '96 privatisation auctions yield $80 mln.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine '96 privatisation auctions yield $80 mln.

text.p: Ukraine has raised about $80 million from investment in companies privatised through share auctions this year, the head of the investment department at the State Property Fund (FDM) said on Thursday.
"Contracts signed by customers at auctions show total investment was 100 million hryvnia plus $26 million," Natalya Prokopovych told an investment conference.
She said the fund, the state privatisation agency, had sold shares in 285 enterprises this year at auctions mostly of machine-building and steel factories.
Residents and non-residents are allowed to buy shares at auctions with cash or with privatisation certificates.
